# IT Security and Performance Protocols

This document outlines key tasks for the IT & Digital department:

*   Optimize firewall settings based on audit recommendations.
*   Investigate API latency on a quarterly basis.
*   Update API latency parameters for the 2026 strategy.
*   Urgently update firewall settings.
*   Investigate database migration based on audit findings.
